verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents an official remote MCP server that lets MCP-compatible AI agents act on your workspace. Once connected, an agent can read and change the same dashboard data you can (organizations, connections, users, branding) by calling the WorkOS API on your behalf, so the product can be operated through natural-language requests to an agent. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface (it relies on an external MCP-compatible agent), detail on which operations and tools are covered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
